text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

-Farstad Shipping, one of Norway's largest supplyship fleets, will benefit from new tax rules. A Conservative majority in parliament is likely to push tax changes governing all kinds of shipping companies, despite the Finance Ministry's recommendation of limiting tax reductions.
-Norway's Aadne Soendraal won the gold medal in the 1,000 metre World championship speed-skating final in Warsaw this weekend.
-Developing countries which receive financial support from Norway spend more on defence than other developing countries, figures from government department Statistics Norway show.

-Norwegian telecommunication companies are rapidly growing. Since 1992 turnover in the sector has nearly doubled. The industry expects to increase revenues from a forecast 10 billion crowns this year to 30 billion crowns in 2005.
